structures.hypothesis: 7-vs-8 separator (S4): Combines S4.1 (No-stem detector (S4.1)), S4.2 (No-stem detector · with an opening at the top) and S4.3 (0/2/5/6 structure (mechanism unknown)). S4.1 feeds S4.2 and S4.3. Together they separate 7s from 8s (96% balanced accuracy, cross-validated) much better than the best part alone (S4.1: 83%). Its strongest exit (map h25): it responds when the image lacks a tall vertical stem: it is held back by a long, near-vertical stroke running most of the digit's height. So it fires on 0s (98%), 6s (96%), 5s (88%), 2s (84%) and 3s (78%), and on 4s that have no tall vertical stem (44% vs 8% without), and on 8s that have no tall vertical stem (42% vs 8% without). Evidence: Overall s = -0.60; within digits s = -0.51 on average over 7 digits; with the amount of ink held fixed, r = -0.16; add_stem edit: -0.50 SD against its control (as predicted).

structures.name: S5
structures.title: Open-top (4-shape) detector
structures.hypothesis: Open-top (4-shape) detector: It responds to a gap that opens upwards between two strokes (the top of a 4). So it fires on 6s (93%) and 4s (82%). Evidence: Overall s = +0.54; within digits s = +0.42 on average over 2 digits; with the amount of ink held fixed, r = +0.34. No image edit tested it (or the edit's effect was too small): supported, not proven.

annotations.name: root
annotations.title: Digit scores from the structures
annotations.hypothesis: Digit scores from the structures: Reads the structures' exits through the ten score maps and the head: each score map is a sum of kernels on the exits (and on the image directly), averaged over the map, and the head mixes the ten averages into the class scores (exact, linear). The largest direct push towards each image's own digit (score margin over the mean score, on images of that digit): '0' by 7-vs-8 separator (S4) (+11.60); '1' by 2-vs-3 separator (S3) (+8.92); '2' by 7-vs-8 separator (S4) (+9.59); '3' by 7-vs-8 separator (S4) (+5.42); '4' by 2-vs-3 separator (S3) (+11.74); '5' by 2-vs-3 separator (S3) (+8.71); '6' by 2-vs-3 separator (S3) (+18.47); '7' by the image directly (+7.56); '8' by Lower-loop detector (+12.21); '9' by Lower-loop detector (+6.29).

suggester.method: attribution flow (gradient x input per edge, all class scores) + activation similarity (r >= 0.8); greedy merging that keeps the groups a DAG (5-8 structures); sub-parts by the same score inside each structure (at most 4 maps each)
